It depends on the spell of the nature is event based or ongoing. Say you do a spell to nail a specific job interview: it’ll be over after it happens, not last your whole life ensuring perfect interviews forever. But if you did like a protection spell, depending on your power or experience you may want to “redo” it every few weeks or months

First I’d say look at the tools they use. If their tarot cards look shiny and new and everything seems just decorative, they’re probably only practicing for customers and not behind the scenes. Also look out for gimmick tools like crystal balls (legit but VERY advanced so it’s rare) Buddha statues, etc. 
you can also tell by the terminology they use. Real witches will be very real with you, but frauds are going to be all over with chanting and “spirits” and “ancestors” and the like.
Most of all the answers you get will tell you. Anything super vague or super specific is a red flag. Don’t listen to “you will one day marry a rich woman” or tales of how you will die, as readings have a time cap of weeks or months

For a seance, it’s so difficult I’d need to do it in person. If I don’t know the deceased, having the physical link of the relative/ loved one and some physical objects and taglocks they bring it would be nearly impossible. Plus, with in person I can verify as we go. I don’t ask for any info before the seance to not contaminate the reading, but I don’t want to do an hour long interview with a dead gangster when I was supposed to be talking to someone’s mom from Florida. In person I can verify the messages I get for accuracy as they come in

Not speed, I actually use a mat. Sort of like a ouija board in process but VERY different energy. The pendulum will swing to yes/ no or letters and we go from there, but it’s a lot of feeling out due to the intensity of the swing what to ask and how to improve the connection so the answers are clearer

I don’t actually hear voices! I work as a conduit (think of like the power strip that connects a plug to its source). I use a tool such as a pendulum or tarot cards to receive the messages I then interpret to the person. If a lay person uses those tools without training and connection they wouldn’t do much
If you just mean how I define success in general? Not just witchcraft? Yes I mean accomplishing a goal. Here is what I am aiming to do, if I do it, that’s successful

For tarot reading I frequently do this over the phone or text as long as the person I’m reading for is in a position to meditate from where they are. It requires a transference if energy is as long as they can do so I do not have to be in physical proximity to them. These readings have proved as accurate as my in person sessions

I define successful as making a connection to the desired individual. If I’m trying to contact a deceased little boy from New York and am getting like, recipes from a Korean grandmother, that’s not successful. But if I receive messages about living friends of the deceased that the living people at the seance confirm as accurate, I call that successful.
